# Working Papers

### 1. **Who Gets Convicted? The Political Economy of Corruption Prosecution Outcomes in Nigeria**  

This project studies the determinants of outcomes of corruption prosecution in Nigeria using original dataset on more than two decades of corruption prosecution cases. I assess how the financial resources available to the defendants and their socio-economic standings influence whether they are convicted or acquitted.
